description.value: Restaurant Kavita is an upscale Indian restaurant in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood, led by Chef Tushar Tondvalkar whose résumé spans Michelin-starred kitchens in Bangkok and respected Vancouver dining rooms including Blue Water Café and Bauhaus. The centrepiece is the Ammakase, a seasonal tasting menu that traces India's regional cuisines using locally sourced BC produce. Named Best Indian 2026 Gold, it is a deliberate destination-dining experience rooted in storytelling and traditional technique.
